final: SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) AS total_income_amount, 1.0 * SUM(income.amount) / SUM(SUM(income.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_combined_income FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY major.college
